behindTheLens.title: Site visit / drone footage capture
behindTheLens.body: iPhone Pro + DJI Mini 4 Pro. Capture 8-12 reference photos covering each room from corner positions + 1 exterior orbit (~3 min footage). Photograph the floorplan if available — even a printed PDF. This is the source of geometric truth that anchors every later prompt.

behindTheLens.title: gpt-image-2 hero stills (3-5x per room)
behindTheLens.body: Feed each reference photo + style-control prompt to gpt-image-2 in image-to-image mode (preserves geometry). Generate 3-5 hero variants per room (golden hour / blue hour / overcast / interior-lit). Pick the best 6 — these are the deliverable stills AND the seeds for video.

behindTheLens.title: seedance-2 walkthroughs (image-to-video)
behindTheLens.body: For each picked hero still: feed it to seedance-2 with a motion prompt ('slow dolly forward, soft golden hour light, 0.5 m/s'). Generate 8s clips at 1080p. 4 walkthroughs total. Re-roll any with morphing artifacts (usually 1 retry suffices).

behindTheLens.title: kling-3 drone orbit + ffmpeg edit
behindTheLens.body: Generate one 12s drone orbit from the exterior hero still on kling-3. Then ffmpeg concat: 6 stills (1s holds with crossfade) + 4 walkthroughs + 1 drone orbit + ambient track. Apply teal-orange LUT. Export 45s reel + standalone stills (PNG 2048px) + 9:16 vertical cut for Instagram.

behindTheLens.title: Deliver + receive feedback
behindTheLens.body: WhatsApp deliverable to construtora + invoice R$8k. Include: 45s 16:9 reel · 45s 9:16 vertical · 6 stills · dossier PDF with property facts overlaid on hero. Offer 1 iteration round bundled (typically used for music change or one room re-staging).

behindTheLens.title: Steal from winners (Meta Ad Library + TikTok CC)
behindTheLens.body: Before any generation: 30 min in Meta Ad Library + TikTok Creative Center for the brand's category. Screenshot top 10 winners. Identify hook patterns (3s opening · pattern interrupt · UGC vs polished). This is the prompt-seed.

behindTheLens.title: gpt-image-2 hook stills batch (10x)
behindTheLens.body: Generate 10 hook still variants from the winning patterns. Different angles, lighting, copy positions. These are the A/B test universe — pick the 3 strongest by gut + send to client for vote.

behindTheLens.title: seedance-2 + Higgsfield Marketing Studio (6-9s each)
behindTheLens.body: Turn 3 picked stills into 6-9s vertical videos via seedance-2 (image-to-video). Parallel: run Higgsfield Marketing Studio with product URL → UGC avatar variant. End with 5-8 video assets ready for ffmpeg.

behindTheLens.title: ffmpeg variant explosion (20+ assets)
behindTheLens.body: Single source 6s video × 5 caption overlays × 4 CTA endings = 100 variants in 2 hours. Use ffmpeg scriptable batch: caption SRT + watermark + 9:16 crop. Export all as .mp4 H.264 8Mbps · Meta-friendly.

behindTheLens.title: Ship + measure + scale winners with humans
behindTheLens.body: Upload 20 variants to Meta/TikTok in 1 ad set. After 72h, identify CPM/CTR winners (typically 2-3 out of 20). Brief a HUMAN UGC creator to remake the winner concept at scale (Arcads/Creatify/real creator) — AI did the testing-phase work, humans scale the gold.

behindTheLens.title: Brief + reference + altitude/light spec
behindTheLens.body: Client describes terrain (house, vineyard, festival, construction site), desired altitude (low FPV 5m vs establishing 80m), time of day (golden hour / blue hour / overcast), and motion (orbit · reveal · flyover · dive). 1-2 reference photos of the actual location anchor everything.

behindTheLens.title: gpt-image-2 hero aerial still
behindTheLens.body: Generate the hero aerial frame first — composition + altitude + light. 3-5 variants. This is the visual contract with client AND the seed image for the video gen step. Get sign-off on the still before burning video credits.

behindTheLens.title: seedance-2 + kling-3 parallel batch (3-5 clips)
behindTheLens.body: From the picked hero: seedance-2 for FPV-style motion (dive, weave, low approach), kling-3 for orbit/reveal/multi-shot continuity. 15s clips at 1080p. Re-roll 1-2 on motion artifacts (camera glitches at the start frame are common).

behindTheLens.title: ffmpeg cut + LUT + drone sound + stabilize
behindTheLens.body: Concat 3-5 clips into a 45-60s reel. Apply teal-orange LUT or natural-cinematic LUT. Layer ambient drone whoosh + wind sound. Optional stabilize if AI motion is too jerky. Export 16:9 master + 9:16 vertical cut + standalone aerial stills (PNG 2048px).

behindTheLens.title: Deliver bundle + iteration round
behindTheLens.body: WhatsApp: ZIP with master reel (45s 16:9) · vertical cut (9:16) · 3-5 standalone clips · 3 stills (PNG). Invoice R$2.8k. Offer 1 iteration round bundled (typically used for music/grade change or 1 clip re-gen). Optional add-on: real DJI Mini 4 Pro pass on-location for ground-truth integration +R$1.5k.

behindTheLens.title: Steal from winners (TikTok Creative Center)
behindTheLens.body: Before generating anything: 30 min in TikTok Creative Center for the brand's region/category. Screenshot top 10 winning TikToks. Identify hook patterns (3s pattern interrupt · POV: format · transformation · UGC selfie). This is the prompt-seed — NEVER skip.

behindTheLens.title: gpt-image-2 hook stills batch (10x)
behindTheLens.body: Generate 10 vertical 9:16 hook still variants from the winning patterns. Different angles, lighting, text overlay positions. These are the A/B test universe for the visual hook — pick the 3 strongest with client (WhatsApp poll).

behindTheLens.title: seedance-2 + higgsfield parallel (5-8 videos)
behindTheLens.body: Turn 3 picked stills into 6-9s vertical videos via seedance-2 (image-to-video, product + abstract hooks). In parallel: higgsfield Marketing Studio UGC for selfie/talking-head variants. End with 5-8 video assets ready for caption + export.

behindTheLens.title: ffmpeg / CapCut variant explosion (20+ assets)
behindTheLens.body: Single source 6-9s video × 5 caption-variants × 4 sound-overlays = 100 variants in 2 hours. Use ffmpeg scriptable batch OR CapCut auto-caption for hands-on polish. Export all as MP4 9:16 1080x1920 H.264 8Mbps · TikTok-friendly.

behindTheLens.title: Ship + measure + remake winners with real humans
behindTheLens.body: Upload 20 variants to TikTok organic (1 per 4 hours rate-limit). After 72h, identify hook-stop + completion-rate winners (typically 2-3 of 20). Brief a HUMAN creator to remake the winner concept at scale — AI did the testing-phase, humans scale the gold.
